anchor.series: out-of-place all_reduce_perf, NCCL 2.28.3, 72 GPUs (18x4) of one GB200 NVL72 rack, 2-32 GiB per rank

audit_findings.conclusion: The published comparison re-derives only as a JOINT (fabric-parameter, software-version, observable-convention) statement. Two engines sharing every declared parameter disagree with each other by 80-118% on completion time (observables differ by definition), and each misses the published series for reasons the publication cannot arbitrate. A comparison without executable observable definitions and declared assumptions is not re-derivable — this is the motivation case for the platform's observable registry and assumption ledgers.
audit_findings.engine_freedom: Engine B's fitted optimum is not even expressible in its input convention (B_fit rejected as non-dyadic; twin at +0.0988% above it), and its completion observable bundles translation knobs with no counterpart in the publication: endpoint-delay 10 (A-AS2-DELAY-POS), local-mem-bw 1600 with per-bundle 3*size/local-mem-bw processing (A-AS2-MEM-BW), active-chunks-per-dimension 1 (A-AS1-CHUNKS-1). Against the essun L0 ring identity at IDENTICAL topology/workload bytes, engine B's Wall time is +80.2% (32 GiB) to +118.1% (2 GiB) higher — an exactly recorded engine-vs-engine disagreement of the same order as the algorithm-convention ambiguity itself.
audit_findings.observable_definition: The published busbw re-derives EXACTLY as algbw*2(r-1)/r (ring convention) at every size — it is an algorithm-convention quantity, not a wire-rate measurement. Read as per-GPU egress under the ring traffic identity it reaches 100.77% of the CAL-A2 900 B/ns per-direction line at 32 GiB (and crosses 100% between 16 and 32 GiB); read under a multicast/in-network reduction identity the same number is 51.10% of the line. The publication does not state the algorithm, so the fabric-utilization claim swings by the exact factor 2(r-1)/r = 71/36 = 1.9722.
audit_findings.omitted_assumptions: Publication-side quantities no engine can pin: the communicator's algorithm at each size (ring vs NVLS/tree), NCCL channel/SM configuration (the same article's in-place 2 GiB row collapses to 5.20 GB/s — a 151x software-stack effect acknowledged in the source), warmup/iteration protocol, and the NVLink-vs-IB path split of the 72-GPU communicator (the article's own NCCL_IB_HCA guidance; staging caveat). None is standard-derived; each moves the re-derived number.
audit_findings.parameter_freedom: No single fixed-B identity covers the series: at the S2 minimax B_fit (fitted on {2,4,8} GiB only) the deviations run -4.7% (2 GiB) to +9.6% (32 GiB held out) — the software-effective bandwidth ramps with size, which a fabric-parameter model cannot express by construction (the S2 known-omission finding, executed here for the record). Even the vendor ceiling line B=900 is CROSSED: at 32 GiB the ceiling-fixed identity is -0.77% off the published time — the published point is faster than the spec-ceiling fabric model, mirroring the busbw>900 crossing of the observable audit.

engines.engine_a: essun L0 (analytical_l0_crossbar at the S2 B_fit diagnostic and the CAL-A2 ceiling-900 line; analytical_l0 ring twin at B=828)
engines.engine_b: ASTRA-sim analytical, pinned Docker 4ce9ecfe (essun/astra-sim-analytical:s1), native Ring AllReduce, congestion-unaware
engines.same_workload_bar: identical workload bytes (floor-bracket payloads) and identical topology file (ring72_gonogo_b828_v1) for the twin legs; ASTRA observables are its Wall time only (no byte accounting)

evidence_level: E0/E1 (exact arithmetic + engine executions of free parameters against a published external measurement, compared CCT-vs-CCT as PROPOSED evidence; no tuning toward the anchor, no label upgrades)

parameter_provenance.L_provenance: A-L0X-LAT / A-L0-LAT registry point; the publication states no latency
parameter_provenance.representability: B_fit is NOT representable in engine B's input convention: the ASTRA adapter (A-AS1-BW-UNIT, 1 GB = 2^30 B) rejects any bandwidth whose GB/s decimal is non-finite — the exact fitted rational is refused by design, never silently rounded; the twin runs at the nearest admissible integer
